name: 48463 · Otisville, MI
findings: ZIP 48463 (Otisville) has 13 nonprofit organizations. 4 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 3 organizations.
